note: The klt build that GRADES this block's T1 state (klt signoff --manifest).
This is deliberately a different pin from layout/toolchain.json, which
pins the klt build that PRODUCED layout/reports/ -- the evidence. The two
have different jobs and move on different clocks:
layout/toolchain.json  klt 0.2.0  produced the DRC/LVS envelopes. Moving
this pin means re-running DRC/LVS and
signoff/toolchain.json klt 0.5.0  reads those envelopes and renders the
tier report. Moving this pin re-grades
existing evidence and produces no new
klt signoff --manifest did not exist in klt 0.2.0, so the grader could not
be pinned to the producer's version even if that were desirable.
signoff/check.sh warns (it does not fail) when the klt on PATH is not this
version: a newer grader is exactly how a newly-added T1 checklist item
reaches this repo, and the drift check against signoff/tier-report.json is
what turns that into a loud, actionable failure.
